input.command:
cd /task/screenshots && for f in *.png; do
  name="${f%.png}"
  H=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$f")
  # Split into 3 vertical sections
  third=$((H / 3))
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${third}:0:0,scale=720:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_p1.png" 2>&1 | tail -1
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${third}:0:${third},scale=720:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_p2.png" 2>&1 | tail -1
  start=$((2*third))
  remain=$((H - start))
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${remain}:0:${start},scale=720:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_p3.png" 2>&1 | tail -1
done
ls /tmp/frames/

Veltrax
Technology Ecosystem Developers Community Blog

ARCHITECTURE/TECHNOLOGY

Helios Consensus, engineered
for parallelism.

A BFT-based proof-of-stake protocol with optimistic block pipelining — finality in 400ms, sustained throughput north of 120,000 TPS.

Consensus Flow

Four stages, sub-second finality.

Helios Consensus Pipeline

Optimistic pipelining overlaps stages — block N+1 begins before N finalizes.
01
PROPOSE
Leader gathers txs into block N
~90ms
02
VOTE
Validator set signs prevote
~120ms
03
PIPELINE
Block N+1 proposed optimistically
~200ms
04
FINALIZE
2/3+ commit in ~400ms
Parallel Throughput

Sealevel-style parallel execution.

Veltrax's execution layer reads each transaction's access list ahead of dispatch, scheduling non-conflicting transactions across all available CPU cores.

Where serial chains process transactions one at a time, Veltrax runs thousands of disjoint state transitions concurrently — without sacrificing EVM compatibility.

Helios Consensus, engineered
for parallelism.

A BFT-based proof-of-stake protocol with optimistic block pipelining — finality in 400ms, sustained throughput north of 120,000 TPS.

Consensus Flow

Four stages, sub-second finality.

Helios Consensus Pipeline

Optimistic pipelining overlaps stages — block N+1 begins before N finalizes.
01
PROPOSE
Leader gathers txs into block N
~90ms
02
VOTE
Validator set signs prevote
~120ms
03
PIPELINE
Block N+1 proposed optimistically
~200ms
04
FINALIZE

Parallel Throughput

Sealevel-style parallel execution.

Veltrax's execution layer reads each transaction's access list ahead of dispatch, scheduling non-conflicting transactions across all available CPU cores.

Where serial chains process transactions one at a time, Veltrax runs thousands of disjoint state transitions concurrently — without sacrificing EVM compatibility.
